controls.control: Parent environment is replaced by an allowlist
controls.evidence: WorkerProcessSecurityPolicyTests and live Python/llama child-process probes

controls.control: Explicit secret-like environment variables are denied by default
Child stdout/stderr capture is disabled by default; opt-in capture is redacted and bounded
Managed workers bind only to an IP loopback address
Managed Python gRPC calls require a random Bearer key stored in a user-only temporary file
Python worker model paths must stay within configured roots
Remote model code remains denied unless explicitly enabled
Python worker enforces request-size, session-count and thread-count bounds
Supervisors reclaim the complete child process tree on restart and shutdown
Security-critical Host, model, model-root, API-key and UI/slots arguments cannot be overridden
Clear-text remote Python worker endpoints are rejected
Read-only model mount and writable temporary-directory boundary
controls.evidence: Kubernetes manifest uses a read-only root filesystem and model PVC plus a size-limited temporary emptyDir

controls.control: Default-deny outbound network policy for local model workers
controls.evidence: NetworkPolicy denies all ingress and egress, then permits only gateway ingress to the mTLS port

controls.control: Non-root identity, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges and syscall profile
controls.evidence: Restricted Pod Security, uid 65532, read-only root, all capabilities dropped, no privilege escalation and RuntimeDefault seccomp

controls.control: Operating-system CPU, memory, process and GPU quotas
controls.evidence: Container resources, namespace quotas, kubelet podPidsLimit and Linux GPU device limits are mandatory deployment inputs

controls.control: Mutual TLS identity for cross-host workers
controls.evidence: Python gRPC server and .NET client enforce client certificate, private key and trusted CA; real handshake test rejects anonymous clients
